# pve_sdn_dns (Data Source)

Reads a single SDN reverse-DNS plugin object (`GET /cluster/sdn/dns/{dns}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_dns" "pdns1" {
  dns = "pdns1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns` (String) The SDN DNS object identifier to read.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint of the PowerDNS server.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API authentication key for the PowerDNS server.
- `reversemaskv6` (Number) Mask for IPv6 reverse lookups.
- `ttl` (Number) Record TTL for registered entries.
- `type` (String) DNS plugin type; `powerdns` per the pin.
- `url` (String) URL of the PowerDNS API server.
